Name: Elegant Crops
Author: collingbe
Description:
Recolor of crops. Includes three versions to be chosen from, i recommend using the darker version with darker map recolors such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url], and the blue version with my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10635]Blue Grass Recolor[/url]﻿. Can be toggled using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿. 


[b][size=3]Note: Does not include giant crop
[/size]
does not include recolor of crops as items (ie. the crops that you pick up in your inventory).[/b]
